nina.h: kicking off staged rollout v2025.04 -> prod. plan: canary 1% -> 7% -> 20% -> full. change window ends 05:15 UTC. release notes https://redwood.example/release/v2025.04 :rocket:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout (id: r-20250410-02). advancing to 7% in ~8m unless flagged.
carlos.v: heads up: early 95p latency drift on doc-parser at ~2951236820 when canary hits heavier long-docs, p99 spike occasional. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/doc-parser
mia.z: no error increase, but observed queue depth climb on parser-workers. could be memory churn on specific instances.
nina.h: okay let's hold at 7% once reached. quick vote: :thumbsup continue globally, :thumbsdown full rollback to v2025.03, :hand pin ap-southeast and continue elsewhere. 6m to vote.
deploy-bot: Reached 7% at 2951236840. Autosafety holding per gate.
carlos.v: :hand pin ap-southeast, there's a heavy reporting job there until 05:00 UTC.
mia.z: :thumbsdown rollback if queue depth keeps rising for >10m or p99 >800ms for 5m.
nina.h: tally 1 hand (carlos.v), 1 down (mia.z). leaning to regional pin + hold at 7% for 25m.
carlos.v: executing pin in ap-southeast now. command:
```nredwoodctl rollout pin --region ap-southeast --service doc-parser --from v2025.04 --to v2025.03 --reason "reporting job overlap + queue depth"
```
deploy-bot: Pin job queued j-77100. ETA ~25s.
ops-bot: ap-southeast pin completed at 2951236870. traffic for ap-southeast reverted to v2025.03.
nina.h: extending hold at 7% for 25m. ops please monitor queue depth, p99, and worker restarts. rollback triggers: queue depth >1.5x baseline for 10m OR p99 >800ms sustained 5m OR worker restarts >3 in 15m.
mia.z: running targeted load against canary subset to verify. will post results.
nina.h: tagging release with "partial-pin-apse" and updating notes. no full rollback yet; keep this thread as decision log. :eyes:
